name: Ridglea Shopping Center
demographics: Ridglea Shopping Center serves the established Camp Bowie Boulevard corridor in west Fort Worth, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income households from the surrounding Ridglea and Ridglea Hills neighborhoods. The trade area consists of families and professionals aged 35-65 with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000, drawn to the area's mix of local businesses and convenient neighborhood services. Shoppers in this area tend to favor locally-owned establishments alongside national retailers, with frequent visits for everyday needs and dining. The center benefits from the historic Camp Bowie district's reputation as a destination for both residents and visitors seeking a more neighborhood-oriented shopping experience.
description: Ridglea Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood retail destination located at 6111 Camp Bowie Boulevard in Fort Worth's historic Ridglea area. Situated along the popular Camp Bowie corridor, this shopping center has served the west Fort Worth community for decades, providing convenient access to a variety of local businesses and services. The center benefits from its prime location on one of Fort Worth's most recognizable commercial boulevards, known for its eclectic mix of shops, restaurants, and professional services. With a solid 4.4-star rating from 138 reviews, Ridglea Shopping Center has maintained its reputation as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination. The property operates daily from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, offering accessible hours for the surrounding residential communities and contributing to the vibrant commercial character of the Camp Bowie district.
